datasets.title: Ethiopia Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.2 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 6% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 5 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 2% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. AI-assisted mapping was used to estimate total building coverage (approximately 6% of estimated total buildings mapped). Data quality metrics include average age of 5 years with 2% of buildings updated in the last 6 months.
